- SLA edits: fine; engineering has reviewed and confirmed the updated response windows are achievable.

Signer authority: if Elena Ruiz (CFO) will sign, we typically accept a signed certificate of incumbency or a single-sentence POA indicating signatory authority. If she signs, procurement can upload the POA to the envelope as an additional attachment.

DocuSign routing: proposed sequence — CustCo signs first (Elena Ruiz), then Redwood COO (Ben Carter) countersigns. Laura will handle the envelope and final clean-copy delivery. If CustCo prefers simultaneous signing we can set parallel recipients, but sequential (CustCo -> Redwood) is standard for us.

I copied Laura and Ben to confirm their availability for the countersign.
